# Pull Request

## Checklist

- [ ] Deployment-only repository respected
- [ ] No manual edits inside `docs/` unless they came from the private monorepo build
- [ ] Source changes belong in the private monorepo
- [ ] English, Ukrainian, and German docs stay in sync
- [ ] No secrets or private paths added
- [ ] Links verified
- [ ] Screenshots attached where relevant
- [ ] License unchanged unless explicitly required

## Notes

Summarize the change and mention any public documentation updates.
